_comment: NeX_Drop Firebase Security Rules — PRD FR-6, §9.1
_deploy: Firebase Console → Realtime Database → Rules → Paste & Publish

active_mode._comment: PRD §9.1: Write = admin only. Read = authenticated device.

last_ping._comment: Windows client writes heartbeat. Admin reads status.

mode_history._comment: Android admin writes history. Windows reads only.

admin_uid._comment: Read-only for all authenticated. Set once during device registration.

offline_alert._comment: Windows writes when offline detected. Admin reads for push notification.

remote_app_link._comment: PRD FR-7: Android admin writes URL. Windows reads and downloads.

$other._comment: PRD §9.1: No anonymous read or write at any layer.
